title: fumaria officinalis subsp. cilicica
intro: Fumaria officinalis subsp. cilicica, commonly known as Cilician fumitory, is a subspecies of plant belonging to the Fumaria genus. It is used in traditional medicine, primarily for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cilician fumitory include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
